mapper.select: SELECT id, visitor_id, session_id, ip, referrer, source, channel, device, browser, os, landing_page, first_time, last_active, pv FROM t_visit WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_visit (visitor_id, session_id, ip, referrer, source, channel, device, browser, os, landing_page, first_time, last_active, pv) VALUES (#{visitorId}, #{sessionId}, #{ip}, #{referrer}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{device}, #{browser}, #{os}, #{landingPage}, #{firstTime}, #{lastActive}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_visit SET last_active = #{lastActive} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE t_visit SET pv = pv + 1, last_active = #{lastActive} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM t_visit WHERE last_active >= #{since}
SELECT PV FROM t_visit_day WHERE stat_date = #{date}
SELECT UV FROM t_visit_day WHERE stat_date = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM t_visit WHERE last_active >= #{since}
SELECT DATE(last_active) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS uv FROM t_visit WHERE last_active >= #{start} AND last_active < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(last_active)
SELECT channel AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM t_visit WHERE last_active >= #{since} GROUP BY channel ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT stat_date AS date, PV AS pv, UV AS uv FROM t_visit_day WHERE stat_date >= #{start} AND stat_date <= #{end} ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT visitor_id, channel, device, browser, landing_page, last_active, pv FROM ( SELECT visitor_id, channel, device, browser, landing_page, last_active, pv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY last_active DESC, session_id DESC) rn FROM t_visit WHERE last_active >= #{since} ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.last_active DESC LIMIT 50
